flags.note: T6, Omniscience resolved, two Acererak and two Force in hand: attacked with Atraxa before looping vs looping at once (signed-off rule: 'Do not cantrip, attack or take Tomb first'); harmless only because B had no white mana.

T4, A cast Show and Tell off Island + Ancient Tomb: Wastelanded the already-tapped Tomb in response vs holding to A's end step (same mana denial, keeps the option); harmless here, but it breaks the 'before they untap, not after a spell' habit.
T5, Ajani + Cat Warrior token vs untapped 7/7 deathtouch Atraxa: no attack vs sending the token alone; a block kills a Cat and flips Ajani to Avenger for free, no block deals 2.

T9 main 2, dead to the board but planning Show and Tell + Omniscience next turn: channelled Boseiju on a Volcanic Island, and B just fetched another Volcanic. A spent a card for nothing. Better: keep Boseiju as the next land drop, or hold it at instant speed for an artifact (Cori-Steel Cutter came down next turn).

Atraxa reveal (no creature in the 10, Karakas had just entered on B's side): took Ponder as the sorcery over Show and Tell. Show and Tell re-deploys Atraxa after the Karakas bounce; Ponder found only lands and a 3rd Aluren. A survived only by drawing Show and Tell (~8%) on turn 8 at 5 life.

T5, library top a known Force of Will (Brainstormed there on T3): cracked Misty main phase for Tropical before Show and Tell, shuffling the Force away; Show and Tell only needed Tomb + Island, and an uncracked Misty could still be cracked in response to Daze as the spare (A drew Omniscience on T7 instead of Force).

Cast Lotus Petal before Brainstorm with Boseiju untapped; the engine then paid Brainstorm with the Petal. Better: Brainstorm off Boseiju, Petal kept in hand. No cost this game (all 4 mana used), but on a Brainstorm miss the Petal is lost for next turn.

Under A's Aluren, with Acererak (5/5, A's only copy) on the battlefield and his enter trigger on the stack, B passed. Better: cast Phlage free (3 to Acererak), then sacrifice Phlage, Ocelot, Cat and Voice to Goblin Bombardment (4 more). Acererak dies, the loop ends, and A is tapped out holding two Stock Ups.

Turn 2 Preordain saw Volcanic and Daze: bottomed Daze and kept Volcanic on top. Keeping both (Volcanic first, then Daze) holds Daze for Alurentell's Veil; on turn 7 a Daze on Veil would have left A at 3 mana with no Aluren.

Turn 6: cast Cutter, then Bolted face (56) and tapped out while A had 3 lands, a Petal and 7 cards. Holding the 3 Volcanics keeps Bolt plus Heat (5 damage) for Acererak's trigger, and Veil does not stop red. Re-flagged here because B's own flag (seq 76) points at a forced pass.

T8, Aluren resolved, one FoW in hand, Boros with Plateau + Quarry open (2 white): cast free Acererak at once vs play Tropical Island + Brainstorm first to dig for a second Force/Acererak (top was Boseiju, Aluren, FoW); after Acererak A had no U to answer the second removal spell (Swords).

T3, Tomb on board and Ponder in hand: fetched Hedge Maze (enters tapped), so no Ponder this turn. Better: basic Island (also safe from Wasteland) and Ponder now; the Petal it likely finds gives two coloured sources for T5 Veil + Show and Tell with a spare Tomb, two turns before Cutter and the Monk mattered.

T4 Atraxa land pick vs Boros (4 Wasteland), board Island + Savannah, next-turn plan Show and Tell (Aluren needs 4 mana, uncastable next turn anyway): took Tropical Island over City of Traitors. Savannah was Wastelanded and A sat on 2 mana; Island + City would have cast Show and Tell -> Omniscience on T6 into a B hand of one land.
T1 cracked Strand and cast Brainstorm main phase; holding the fetch and doing both at the opponent's T2 end step cost nothing and showed their turn first (Wasteland decoy too)

One-land hand with DRC: cast Bauble first (no surveil) and later activated it on the opponent after Delta was cracked; better Delta, Volcanic, DRC, then Bauble for a surveil, and Bauble on self or held

T4, Island untapped, hand 2 Ancient Tomb + Hedge Maze (all nonbasic), Stock Up known on top, B's Wasteland on the battlefield: cast Brainstorm then played Hedge Maze tapped (1 mana used; Wasteland then took the Maze, A's only green source). Better: Tomb + Stock Up (3 mana, see 5, keep Brainstorm); Wasteland takes one nonbasic anyway.

Turn 7: passed with 3 lands, Show and Tell, Omniscience, 2 Force, 2 Veil, no land in hand; B: Volcanic tapped, Wasteland untapped, Daze spent. Jam Show and Tell for Omniscience with Force backup; waiting needed a land draw, and the visible Wasteland took Tropical at end step (hindsight: B's 2 Forces beat it anyway).

Turn 6 main 2: held Wasteland (a second Wasteland known on top) vs A's 3 nonbasic lands and Show and Tell in hand; fired only at A's turn-7 end step. Wasteland Tropical now, before A untaps, so A has no 3-mana Show and Tell window; the Wasteland mana went unused on A's turn anyway.

T7, opp at 13 with only an untapped Atraxa and a known Acererak/Boseiju: attacked with Ocelot alone and stacked 4 Guide triggers on it (Atraxa blocked, A stayed at 13). Better: attack with all 5 able creatures (no blockers needed at 35 life), so Atraxa must still block the 9/9 and A falls to 8, or spread the counters for about 11 damage.

T4 vs Alurentell with no Force/Daze in hand: cast Brainstorm main phase then Preordain, tapping out into A's Aluren turn. Better: Preordain now, keep Volcanic + Brainstorm for A's turn so a Daze found in response is castable (Cutter, also tapping out, was no better). Outcome-neutral here: no counter in the cards seen.

T8, one land, opp just showed 4 mana and Show and Tell: tapped the only Volcanic main phase for Ponder. Holding R for Unholy Heat (delirium on, 6 damage) kills the 5/5 Acererak with his enter trigger on the stack and stops the T9 Aluren loop; A had one Acererak and no Force or Veil.

T3: played Plains and held Wasteland, though B had seen Hedge Maze (A's only land) and a surveilled Omniscience. Better: play Wasteland (Plains + Wasteland casts Ajani) and destroy Maze in A's T4 upkeep, so A has only Tomb (colourless), cannot Stock Up and falls a turn behind a clock that was one turn from lethal.

T7 at 15 vs Cutter+Monk+DRC: played Misty and cracked it (1 life) to shuffle a known City off the top while holding Tropical Island and Ponder; Ponder first, then Tropical from hand, is free. A later died at exactly 2 life to a Tomb tap, so that point was the margin.

Brainstorm put back Ponder (the only blue card) and Bolt, then Delta shuffled them away, leaving Force of Will with no pitch card from T6 on; B had no answer to A's T9 Show and Tell and survived only because A's Tomb tap killed A. Put back Volcanic Island + Bolt instead.
Declined to move Cori-Steel Cutter #47 from the non-sick Monk onto the new Monk token: Yes gives the token haste and trample and raises the attack from 9 to 10 (A to 1 instead of 2).

T4: cracked Flooded Strand after Ponder had left Murktide and Force of Will on top, shuffling both away. Better: crack Strand first, then Ponder (same mana). That Force would have been in hand on the combo turn.

T6: tapped out for Cori-Steel Cutter + Ponder against a 7-card combo opponent on 3 lands. Better: hold Bolt + Unholy Heat (3 mana, 7 damage) to kill Acererak with his trigger on the stack and force out A's Force of Will. A won next turn without any response from B.
Atraxa reveal vs Boros: took Veil of Summer for the instant slot over Brainstorm. Veil is a blank vs Boros (playbook); Brainstorm under Omniscience is 3 free cards. No impact this game.

Brainstorm put back Tundra then Tropical (both lands in hand) keeping dead Omniscience and Misty, vs a deck that showed Wasteland; put back Omniscience + Misty and keep a land, so t9 Aluren (Island+Maze+Tundra+Petal, GG) is live after the double Wasteland

T5: played Misty and cracked it main 1 (fetched Savannah) though the untapped Island paid for Ponder, vs a deck that had just Wastelanded Boseiju; better: Ponder off Island, keep Misty uncracked (Wasteland-proof) until the Show turn. Savannah died next turn and A stayed on 3 lands.

T8, own Force on the stack, Tropical untapped: cast Veil (tapping Tropical) and B Dazed the Force on top of Veil; better: pass holding Tropical to pay for Daze, Veil only in response to a Force. Lost Force, Atraxa and Veil to a 1/1 DRC.

Discarded Atraxa #2 to hand size (kept Trop, Strand, Misty); with no Acererak in hand it was the only Show and Tell payoff once Swords hit Atraxa #1. Discard Strand + spare Stock Up instead: A drew Show and Tell next turn with nothing to put in.

T9 Brainstorm put-back: put back the second Acererak (with Omniscience) and kept Misty + Boseiju; better put back a land to redraw and keep both Acererak. T11 Heat killed the lone Acererak under Aluren; a spare would have looped and won (B had only Delta left).
Chose Done after taking Aluren and Force from Atraxa, leaving Ponder, Lotus Petal, a land and Atraxa; playbook says take every card on the combo turn (backup if the loop is broken).

T5 Force of Will on Aluren with both Volcanics tapped: pitched Daze, keeping uncastable Brainstorm and Preordain. Pitching a cantrip keeps 2 Daze against A's 1 spare Petal: Daze A's Force-back twice (or the free Acererak twice) and the turn-5 kill fails.

T2 one-land six with Aluren+Acererak, land drop is Hedge Maze (tapped): cast Lotus Petal to Ponder now. Alternative: hold Petal, Ponder off the untapped Maze on T4 before the land drop (same depth by T4). Turn 8 A had 3 lands after Wasteland; the saved Petal is the 4th mana for Aluren + free Acererak before Boros's T9 lethal.

T2 Brainstorm with Island as the land and no fetch to shuffle: put back Veil and City, then drew the known City on t4. The better line was Ponder on t2 (it can shuffle) and Brainstorm on t4 with Misty to crack. Small cost, but the 'weave the fetch' rule applied.

Erode on a tapped, summoning-sick Atraxa while Karakas was untapped and can bounce a legendary Atraxa for free at instant speed. B knew A held Omniscience and a second Atraxa; holding Erode for the Acererak trigger was the only out on A's kill turn (A's free Atraxa then found Force, so it likely would not have mattered).

Passed B's turn-4 end step with Misty uncracked; a hand with no enabler and no cantrip could fetch Hedge Maze #2 (enters tapped, surveil 1) for 1 life, the only extra look the deck offered. A never did, and drew Tomb, Strand, Tomb before Aluren on t9.

At 5 life facing exactly 5 power, hardcast Acererak for one Lost Mine scry; it cost the Petal (only black source) and 2 life to Tomb auto-pay (Petal+Maze+Trop was painless). Holding was better; outcome unchanged.

Turn 3: tapped Wasteland to cast Voice of Victory; Wasteland on Hedge Maze (A's only land) leaves A with Savannah+Petal = 2 mana on turn 4, so no Show and Tell for Atraxa until turn 6 and Boros gets two more attacks.

Channeled Boseiju on a tapped Volcanic; B fetched an untapped Volcanic and the dead land was its 4th delve card, so Murktide cost exactly B's 3 t6 lands. Playing Boseiju as a land kept a second G source (no Misty+Tomb payment, 3 life, on the t9 Aluren).

Ponder showed Prismari Charm, Daze, Island; B shuffled. Against Alurentell, Charm (bounces Aluren in response to Acererak) and Daze (Force pitch) are the anti-combo cards; Delta/Wasteland already covered lands.
Brainstorm put-back Daze (then Delta shuffle) over Bolt. Held, Daze is the blue pitch for FoW #74 on the t9 Aluren, which A could not have answered (A's FoW had no pitch).

DRC surveil put Prismari Charm (top card, B's t8 draw) into the graveyard for zero delirium (graveyard only instants). Charm with 3 Volcanics open bounces Aluren in response to the free Acererak and wins; this decided the game.

Wasteland on Ancient Tomb vs Hedge Maze. A's G sources were Maze + Misty; killing Maze leaves one G so Aluren (GG) is off on t9, while Show and Tell is castable either way. Tomb hit let the t9 Aluren happen.

Cracked Misty at B's turn-4 end step (Hedge Maze) into an untapped Wasteland, shuffling away a known Petal on top. Better: hold it, draw the Petal on turn 5, cast the Petal, crack in main 1 for a dual and cast Show and Tell (Atraxa, Force backup) at once, paying with the dual before Wasteland can answer. Decided the game.
Cracked both Mishra's Baubles on turn 2 (b30, b33) with no DRC in play and no fetch. Holding them for the turn-4 DRC would have given surveil triggers and earlier delirium. Low impact here.

T2 played Volcanic Island and tapped it for DRC (with Wasteland, Island, FoW, Bolt in hand) while A had 0 lands and an uncracked Misty. Alternative: Wasteland as the land drop, Bauble, hold it untapped and destroy whatever Misty fetches (Hedge Maze was A's only GG source with Petal), which denies the turn-3 Aluren that killed B.
Cast Mishra's Bauble before Dragon's Rage Channeler, missing the DRC surveil trigger; cast DRC first, then the Bauble (minor).

T6 second Atraxa reveal: took Acererak and Omniscience, then Done, leaving Stock Up, Lotus Petal, Ancient Tomb and Show and Tell behind; the playbook says take every card on the combo turn, as backup if the loop is answered again.

T5, after Swords on the Show-and-Tell Atraxa, cast Amped Raptor and tapped all 3 Plateaus although the Atraxa reveal showed Omniscience + Show and Tell in A's hand. Alternative: skip Raptor and keep 2 W open for Swords on Acererak next turn; only the Marsh Flats B put in with A's Show and Tell gave it W.

Passed with FoW (Murktide pitch) while Veil of Summer was on the stack. Once Veil resolved, FoW was dead against Show and Tell. Forcing Veil, pitching Murktide, gives delirium (land, artifact, instant, creature), so the two Unholy Heats deal 6 and kill Acererak on his trigger. It was B's only live line.

T5 with 2 lands vs Alurentell (A showed Brainstorm, Ponder, Tundra, Maze): cast Amped Raptor with 2 Goblin Bombardments in hand. Better: Bombardment, since it must be on the battlefield before A's 3-land Aluren turn; Guide, Ajani and Cat plus free Guide and Scout under Aluren make 5 pings on the 5/5 Acererak (A's Force on one free creature still saves it).

Under A's Aluren with Acererak on the stack, passed four times instead of casting Guide of Souls for free (the Boros note says to cast free creatures under their Aluren). No effect here because there were no Swords, but it is a missed habit.

T5, A's Veil of Summer on the stack, A left with exactly Island + Ancient Tomb (Show and Tell's cost): passed, then wasted Daze and Force (pitching Prismari Charm) into the resolved Veil. Daze on Veil (A pays 1 and loses the Show and Tell turn) or Force on Veil plus Daze on Show and Tell was better.

T6 under Omniscience: cast the first Acererak holding one Force of Will while B had 4 cards and 4 untapped W; Swords drew the Force and Erode killed him. A third Atraxa and Brainstorm (both free) were in hand with library 39 vs 18 life: recast Atraxa first to find a second Force or backup Acererak.

T1 Elegant Parlor surveil put Wasteland in the graveyard vs Alurentell (opponent had no land yet). Keeping it: T3 Wasteland + Parlor still casts Raptor and kills A's only land (Tundra), or holds for Ancient Tomb.

T7 Brainstorm in response to B's Force on Show and Tell (hand Force, Veil, S&T, Atraxa, 2 Acererak, no mana left): put back S&T + Acererak, leaving Atraxa as the only blue pitch. Better: put back Veil + Acererak, Force pitching the spare S&T, S&T resolves into Atraxa (B had no second counter).

Cast Force of Will on B's Force with Atraxa the only blue card (auto-pitched), so S&T resolved with just Acererak and B got a free DRC. Alternative: let S&T be countered, keep Force + Atraxa + Veil, S&T known on top for a T9 Veil + S&T.

T5 vs Alurentell (opp 7 cards, 2 lands): cast Sand Scout #2 tapping both Plateaus, leaving only Quarry (one W). Holding W, W plus Quarry keeps Swords and Erode both live against one Force of Will for the first Acererak; Scout is free under their Aluren anyway. A jammed into the single answer and won that turn.

DRC surveil after Force-for-Force: binned Brainstorm, the only blue pitch for B's last Force (hand: FoW, 3 Cutter, Falls) and no delirium gain. Keeping it on top draws it turn 10, and Force pitching it counters A's tapped-out Aluren on turn 11; binning it lost the game.

T4 second Ponder saw Strand, Petal, Aluren with Show and Tell already in hand and no creature: kept Aluren on top, no shuffle. Playbook says shuffle a creature-less look with a creature-dependent hand (~8/49 to hit Atraxa/Acererak); the cost is losing the known Petal that became turn-6 mana.
DRC surveil (from end-step Bolt) binned Daze against a combo deck; Bolt was adding the instant type anyway, so keeping Daze on top was better (existing note: never surveil away Daze).

Turn 8 Main 2: tapped both Volcanics for delve Murktide with A at 6 cards and 3 lands (Aluren next turn). Passing with 2 Force + Daze and the DRC clock (A at 8) was better; breaks the existing tap-out note.

Forced back (pitching Daze) to save Murktide after A's Force, leaving Force of Will + 2 red Cutters (no pitch): the last Force was dead for A's Aluren turn. Letting Murktide die kept Force + Daze vs an A with no Force left.

A's Aluren in play, Acererak on the stack, A out of Force: B passed with Guide of Souls and Amped Raptor (both free under Aluren) in hand. Guide then Raptor with the trigger on the stack discovers off energy (Swords/Erode/Bombardment); low equity vs A's spare Acererak, but B's only out.

Played Scalding Tarn with two Wastelands in hand while A's only mana land was Tropical Island (fetches uncracked); Wasteland on Tropical before A untapped (second one on turn 6) delays Aluren 1-2 turns into B's two Daze. B never used either Wasteland and lost on turn 7.

Brainstorm put back Daze (and Ponder) while keeping a second Wasteland and Bolt; against a combo deck put back Wasteland #2 or Bolt and keep both Daze. Not decisive here (A had exactly 2 spare mana on the combo turn).

T3 (B's 2nd turn) cast Voice of Victory with Plateau+Quarry, tapping out with Swords in hand after seeing Tundra+Brainstorm; alternative: land and pass with W up to Swords the first Acererak on its ETB trigger (A held only one Acererak, had no 3rd land and a known Aluren draw). Voice cannot stop a combo on A's own turn.

T7 with exactly 3 mana, Show and Tell + Aluren + Acererak in hand, opp's only land tapped on its own turn and Daze already spent: cast Stock Up (dig for Tomb). Show and Tell putting in Aluren, then free Acererak, faces the same Daze/Force risk but wins on resolution (it would have won here, two turns early).

T8 with exactly Volcanic + Island and Prismari Charm in hand, Aluren visible in opp's graveyard: tapped out for a delve-5 Murktide. Holding UR for Charm bounces Aluren in response to the free Acererak and stops the T9 kill; Murktide can wait for a third land (Delta in hand).

T2 main 1 after Hedge Maze (Acererak known on top, Aluren in hand): passed with 2 Petals in hand. Better: cast both now, because Boros has 3 Spider-Woman (B held one) that would make next-turn Petals enter tapped and kill the turn-2 Aluren, and Boros has no game-1 artifact removal.

T3, Trop + Tomb untapped: passed with Stock Up castable, intending to cast it at their end step, but it is a sorcery. Casting it here digs a turn earlier, which likely means T5 Veil + Show and Tell for Atraxa at about 14 life instead of T7 at 4 life.

T3 with Plains + Plateau, after seeing A Brainstorm and cast 2 Petals early: cast Amped Raptor. Better: Goblin Bombardment, the one card that cannot be cast free under their Aluren. Keep Ajani, 2 Voice and Raptor to cast free in response to Acererak; 6+ bodies, sacrifice 5 on his enter trigger and the loop ends (A had no second Acererak).

T5 cast Ponder off Hedge Maze (only untapped land) before the land drop with opp's Volcanic untapped (Daze live); Daze countered it. Ancient Tomb in hand, played first, pays Daze's 1, and the land choice did not depend on the Ponder. Tests Brady's cantrip-before-land rule against Daze.

T7 Force of Will on Aluren pitched Prismari Charm (only copy) over Murktide Regent. Charm is UR's only answer to a resolved Aluren (bounce it in response to Acererak's trigger); without it the T9 Aluren + Acererak loop was unanswerable.

T8 tapped both lands for a delve-5 Murktide against Alurentell (Aluren seen, 4 cards in hand) while holding Bolt + Heat; the delve also removed delirium (land/sorcery/instant/artifact) so Heat would have dealt 6. Holding R open breaks the existing 'do not tap out for Murktide' note; A won next turn.

T2: cast Mishra's Bauble before Dragon's Rage Channeler and later pointed it at A (saw Hedge Maze). DRC first, then Bauble, gives a surveil trigger; or Bauble on self before cracking Delta. Small, but the existing note already covers it.
